title: The next phase of the Microsoft OpenAI partnership
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI and Microsoft announce an amended agreement that simplifies the partnership, adds long-term clarity, and supports continued AI innovation at scale....
body:
